apis.name: User & Car Management API
apis.description: Manages users and cars. Cars are saved in a 'cars' collection and as a summary within 'users'.

services.name: UserService
services.description: Handles registration, profiles, and adding cars to drivers.
services.signature: getUserById(String id), registerUser(User user), addCarToDriver(String userId, Car car)

repositories.name: UserRepository
repositories.signature: findById(String id), findByEmail(String email), save(User user)

apis.name: Ride Publication & Search API
apis.description: Cross-database search (Neo4j for paths, Mongo for details).

services.name: RideSearchService
services.description: Finds rides via Neo4j (including intermediate stops) and retrieves details from Mongo.
services.signature: searchRides(String fromCity, String toCity), publishRide(Ride ride)

repositories.name: RouteRepository
repositories.description: Neo4jRepository. Searches for route_id in the GPS points graph.

repositories.name: RideRepository
repositories.description: MongoRepository. Filters for OPEN status and available seats.

apis.name: Booking Flow API (Redis + Mongo)
apis.description: Booking lifecycle: transient state on Redis and persistence on Mongo.

services.name: BookingProcessService
services.description: Orchestrates the transition from Redis to Mongo, updates seats, and maps complex DTOs.

repositories.name: BookingRepository
repositories.description: MongoRepository. Saves final bookings with Driver/Passenger summaries.
repositories.signature: save(Booking b), findByPassengerId(String id), findByDriverId(String id)

apis.name: Analytics & Statistics API
apis.description: Financial metrics and price suggestions based on aggregations.

services.name: AnalyticsService
services.description: Provides historical reports and calculates suggested prices per km.
services.signature: getRevenueStats(String start, String end), getPriceStats(int distanceKm)

repositories.name: AnalyticsRepository
repositories.description: MongoRepository. Range query on the 'analytics' collection.

apis.name: Feedback & Rating API
apis.description: Bidirectional reviews with automatic user average rating recalculation.

services.name: FeedbackService
services.description: Saves reviews and updates the ReviewStats (averageRating) object for the user.

data_transfer_objects.name: BookingRequestDTO
data_transfer_objects.usage: Input for the booking request and finalization phase.

data_transfer_objects.name: BookingResponseDTO
data_transfer_objects.usage: Detailed output for the frontend; aggregates data from Booking, Ride, and User.
data_transfer_objects.fields: id, rideId, bookingDate, paymentStatus, finalPrice, carPlate, driver (UserSummaryDTO), passenger (UserSummaryDTO), locations (LocationDTO)

data_transfer_objects.name: UserSummaryDTO
data_transfer_objects.usage: Lightweight user representation to avoid sending sensitive or heavy data.

data_transfer_objects.name: FeedbackDTO
data_transfer_objects.usage: Data transport for submitting reviews and ratings.
